requirement.description: The _expand_targets method in NotifyNextcloud class has issues with target expansion and group resolution that causes test failures. Specifically, when expanding targets like 'all' or groups (#group), the method returns an empty list instead of properly resolving users, leading to failed notifications.

contract.description: The _expand_targets method should properly resolve all users when target is 'all', and should resolve users in groups when targets start with '#' prefix. The method should return a list of resolved user targets, or return False if expansion fails completely.
contract.input: targets: list of target strings (user names, 'all', or '#group')
contract.output: List of resolved user targets or False if expansion fails

behavior.item: When target is 'all', should resolve all users and return them
When target starts with '#', should resolve users in that group
When target is a regular user, should return as-is
Should handle None/empty responses from API calls gracefully

requirement.description: The Apprise class instantiate method fails to properly validate and return instances. Several tests fail because isinstance() checks return False instead of proper NotifyBase instances, indicating the instantiate method isn't properly creating objects.

contract.description: The instantiate method should return a proper NotifyBase instance when given valid parameters, or None when instantiation fails. The method should handle all valid input types (strings, dictionaries) and properly validate schema existence.
contract.input: url: string or dict representing notification URL, asset: AppriseAsset (optional), tag: string or list (optional), suppress_exceptions: boolean (default True)

behavior.item: Should parse URL strings correctly and instantiate plugins
Should return None for invalid URLs or unsupported schemas

requirement.description: The sendgrid plugin has issues with email address validation that causes test failures. The plugin fails to properly validate email addresses, particularly when checking for valid email formats in the notify() method.

contract.description: The sendgrid plugin should properly validate email addresses and handle invalid emails gracefully. When an invalid email address is provided, the plugin should either reject it or handle it gracefully without throwing exceptions.
contract.input: body: notification body, title: notification title, notify_type: notification type

behavior.item: Should handle invalid email addresses gracefully
Should return False when notification fails due to invalid email

requirement.description: The CLI persistent storage test fails because the test expects certain file IDs to be present in the storage listing, but they're not found. This suggests the storage mechanism isn't creating files with the expected naming convention or the listing logic is incorrect.

contract.description: The CLI persistent storage functionality should properly create and list storage files with expected naming patterns. The test should verify that storage files are created with the correct IDs and can be listed properly.
contract.input: Storage path, config file with storage-enabled entries
contract.output: Storage file listing with expected IDs

behavior.item: Should create storage files with deterministic IDs
Should list storage files correctly with matching IDs
Should handle file operations without errors
